blocks.text: Statistics mathematics ki woh shaakh (branch) hai jo data ko samajhne aur us ka jaiza lene mein madad deti hai. Statistics se hum bohat sari maloomat ka saada khulasa (summary) bana sakte hain, jis se nateeja nikalna aasan ho jata hai. Kuch bunyadi statistical concepts yeh hain: descriptive statistics, measures of central tendency (markaz batane wale paimane), measures of dispersion (phailao batane wale paimane) aur probability (imkan).

blocks.prompt: Is hisse ke chaar bunyadi statistical concepts bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Descriptive statistics, measures of central tendency, measures of dispersion aur probability.

items: Statistics data ka khulasa karti hai: descriptive statistics, central tendency, dispersion, probability.
